description:
PRESOLICITATION NOTICE

Agency: Department of Health & Human Services (HHS)
Operating Division: National Institutes of Health (NIH)
Institute: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)

PSC Code: DA10 – IT and Telecom – Business Application/Application Development Software (Commercial Software)
NAICS Code: 513210 – Software Publishers

Requirement:
The National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) intends to procure a renewal of Uptrends software licenses, consisting of:

  • ITRS Uptrends Business License – Quantity: 1

  • Uptrends Legacy Licenses – Quantity: 85

The Government’s current licenses have lapsed. The anticipated period of performance is one (1) year from date of delivery/activation.

Acquisition Approach:
This requirement is for commercial products/services and will be conducted in accordance with FAR Part 12. The Government intends to use streamlined acquisition procedures to the maximum extent practicable.

Set-Aside Determination:
This requirement is anticipated to be issued on an unrestricted basis. The Government may not issue a formal solicitation and may conduct oral solicitations. All responsible sources may submit a quote for consideration in response to this notice.

Submission Information:
Interested vendors may submit quotes in response to this notice. Quotes shall be submitted via email to jesse.weidow@hhs.gov.
